nodes.label: Auto-detect Module Directories Pattern
nodes.rationale: Any root-level folder containing a .psd1 whose name matches the folder is treated as a module. No workflow changes needed to add new modules — just create the folder.

nodes.label: VB.DNSEnrichment Developer Fix TODO (v0.4.0 to v0.5.0)
nodes.author: VB + Claude
nodes.norm_label: vb.dnsenrichment developer fix todo (v0.4.0 to v0.5.0)

nodes.label: Enrichment Context Object ($ctx)
nodes.author: Vibhu Bhatnagar
nodes.rationale: The context object is produced by Get-VBEnrichmentContext and passed to every function. It probes the environment once, sets capability flags, and is the foundation of the entire module. No layer function re-detects capabilities — they read flags from $ctx.

nodes.label: 11-Layer IP Enrichment Pipeline
nodes.author: Vibhu Bhatnagar
nodes.rationale: Layers run in priority order (most reliable passive sources first, then active probes). Skip-if-resolved gate avoids redundant work. Enrichment-only layers (TCP, ARP, OUI) always run.

nodes.label: DNSEnrichment SQLite Schema (Enrichment + EnrichmentHistory)
nodes.author: VB + Claude
nodes.rationale: SQLite chosen over CSV/SQL Server: file-based, zero install, survives runs without licensing. Two tables: Enrichment (one row per IP, upserted) and EnrichmentHistory (append-only audit log for DHCP churn detection).

nodes.label: DNSEnrichment Coding Standards (Non-Negotiable)
nodes.author: VB + Claude
nodes.rationale: No aliases, no Get-WmiObject, named parameters only, no Write-Host, no silent catches, all functions return PSCustomObject, CmdletBinding required, TCP/COM in finally blocks, PS5.1 cert callback reset in finally.

nodes.label: PS 5.1 Compatibility-First Strategy
nodes.author: VB + Claude
nodes.rationale: Baseline is PS 5.1. PS7 features (ForEach-Object -Parallel, -SkipCertificateCheck) used only where meaningful and always behind context flags. Never put #Requires -Version 7 at module level.

nodes.label: Skip-If-Resolved Gate Pattern
nodes.author: VB + Claude
nodes.rationale: Orchestrator tracks IsResolved. Hostname-resolving layers are skipped for IPs already resolved. Enrichment-only layers (TCP, ARP, OUI) always run. The orchestrator owns the gate — layer functions don't know they were skipped.

nodes.label: DHCP Churn Detection via EnrichmentHistory
nodes.author: VB + Claude
nodes.rationale: EnrichmentHistory table captures every transition of Hostname, MAC, or DeviceClass between runs. Used to detect IPs that flipped between hostnames, track a device across IPs, and identify stuck cached rows.

nodes.label: Bug C-01: TCP Timeout 300ms Too Short
nodes.author: VB + Claude
nodes.rationale: 300ms insufficient on routed networks. Cameras, printers, VoIP phones drop out. Fix: raise to 1000ms in Get-VBTCPFingerprint.ps1 and context defaults.
nodes.norm_label: bug c-01: tcp timeout 300ms too short

nodes.label: Bug C-02: SQL Injection in SQLite Cache-Load
nodes.author: VB + Claude
nodes.rationale: IP strings interpolated directly into SQL IN clause. Fix: use named @paramN placeholders with PSSQLite parameterized query.
nodes.norm_label: bug c-02: sql injection in sqlite cache-load

nodes.label: Bug C-03: mDNS Guard Condition Logically Inverted
nodes.author: VB + Claude
nodes.rationale: Double-negated condition evaluates to wrong polarity. Runs browse when mDNS unavailable and no-context path. Fix: replace with simple positive check ($Context -and $Context.mDNSAvailable).
nodes.norm_label: bug c-03: mdns guard condition logically inverted

nodes.label: Bug C-04: Parallel Runspaces Rebuild All One-Shot Caches
nodes.author: VB + Claude
nodes.rationale: Import-Module inside ForEach-Object -Parallel gives each runspace fresh script scope, nulling all script-scope caches. Fix: guard Import-Module with module-already-loaded check, pre-warm OUI table and pass via $using:.
nodes.norm_label: bug c-04: parallel runspaces rebuild all one-shot caches

nodes.label: WebDAV Protocol Integration Pattern
nodes.author: Vibhu Bhatnagar
nodes.rationale: Uses HttpWebRequest for PS 5.1 compatibility. PUT for upload, PROPFIND for listing. Turns manual file collection into a single command that auto-creates remote folder structure.

nodes.label: SHA-256 File Deduplication Pattern
nodes.author: Vibhu Bhatnagar
nodes.rationale: Re-importing the same log file is safely skipped via SHA-256 hash stored per imported file. Avoids duplicate records without requiring file path comparison.

nodes.label: Parse-Once SQLite Backend Strategy
nodes.author: VB
nodes.rationale: Original approach re-parsed 450MB files on every question — minutes per question. SQLite solves this: parse once, store, query in milliseconds forever. Same PSSQLite dependency as DNSEnrichment.

nodes.label: Windows Printer Registry Key Pattern
nodes.author: Vibhu Bhatnagar
nodes.rationale: UNC path \\server\printer stored as ,,server,printer in registry. Four migration types: UNC->UNC, UNC->IP, IP->UNC, IP->IP. Machine-level port/printer must be created first for IP destinations. Function must run locally for IP mappings.

nodes.label: VB.NextCloud Soft Runtime Dependency on WorkstationReport
nodes.author: Vibhu Bhatnagar
nodes.rationale: VB.NextCloud is a soft dependency — only required when using -UploadToNextcloud parameter on Invoke-VBWorkstationReport.
nodes.norm_label: vb.nextcloud soft runtime dependency on workstationreport
